reviewQuestions.question: OrderService.calculateTotal moved from OrderController.calculateTotal with identical logic. Do its tests still cover it in the new place?
Work now goes through a queue to OrderCreatedHandler.process. What happens if the consumer fails — is it retried, and is there a dead-letter queue?
OrderController.create no longer mixes responsibilities. Is the observable behavior the same (status codes, errors, response body)?
POST /orders: the simulated response time went from ~292 ms to ~29 ms because work left the request path. Does the client still get everything it needs in the response?
